What this view says:
Just over half of the specified surface area is rated, but only a quarter of vendors are: the rated vendors supply the big-area materials (textiles, wallcovering, carpet, bedding), while many smaller decorative and lighting lines are unrated.
Coverage rests on a few vendors: the top 5 = 71% of rated surface area. Momentum Textiles & Wallcovering and P/Kaufmann Contract alone are 43%, and Justin David Textiles' blackout fabric adds another 14%.
Purchase-order spend is not available yet, so coverage is measured by surface area until purchasing data comes in.

Guestrooms are more consistently rated than public space, which draws on far more vendors (103 vs. 34) for a broader mix of finishes, lighting and decor. Vendors that supply both spaces count in each. Public-space areas show FF&E and the finishes the purchasing team assigned to an area (carpet, wallcovering); architectural finishes such as tile, stone, paint and ceilings are shown on one line until they are assigned. The area rows add up to the Public Space total. Restaurant & Bar includes the terrace bar; Lobby & Lounges includes the terrace lobby and lower-level lounges; Meetings & Events covers the ballroom, boardroom, classrooms and breakout rooms. Items tagged to more than one area (for example the typical public wallcovering and the prefunction carpet) are on "Shared across areas". Vendors that supply several areas count in each.

Starter is 9% of surface area (31,823 sq ft); most of it is Justin David Textiles' blackout fabric (25,685 sq ft, Starter 90). Of rated surface area, 29% is Leader, 54% Achiever and 17% Starter. The largest-area textiles and wallcovering are mostly Achiever. Four vendors (MDC Interior Solutions, Momentum Textiles & Wallcovering, P/Kaufmann Contract and Signature Flooring) have products in two tiers, so they count in each.

Supplier answers from the Mindclick recommendation export for each vendor's product. Where an option covers several product lines with different answers, each line is shown. Grey text marks no data or not yet addressed; "Factory Data Needed" means the supplier left a factory answer blank (factory, carbon emissions, fair labor practices); "No data" means another answer was left blank. "Select" applies that vendor in the scenario builder above.
Score = the sum, across every product in the space, of (product surface area ÷ the space's total surface area) × the product's overall score; unrated products score 0. This reproduces Mindclick's scores (71 overall, 78 Guestrooms, 63 Public Space). Price tier ($ to $$$$) is each vendor's typical price per sq ft of surface area relative to the market for the same product type, from historical Mindclick projects (purchase orders and bids); not a quote. $ is under 0.75× the market, $$ 0.75–1.10×, $$$ 1.10–1.50×, $$$$ over 1.50×; shown only where at least two projects back it. SKUs that share the same vendor options are grouped into one item, because the recommendation export gives surface area per vendor product family rather than per SKU; where an option spans product families, its score is area-weighted.     Opportunities

    The biggest opportunities to raise coverage

    Which unrated products, if rated, would move the needle most?

    The prize: ~165,500 sq ft (47% of specified surface area) sits with 137 unrated product lines (381 SKUs) from 91 named vendors plus a block of items with no vendor named. Rating the top 5 named vendors by unrated area takes rated surface area from 53% to 64%; Burch Fabrics' seating fabrics and vinyls alone add 3.6 points. A further 19% of area is specified without a manufacturer; Mindclick has recommended rated vendors for most of it (see Recommendations).
